_why: Skill-candidates row 'a hollow-kill detector'. Each condition of `hollow_kill` / `replacement_span` and each place it is wired, disabled once.

mutations.name: the-site-is-the-outermost-frame-in-the-file
mutations._mechanism: Reads the FIRST frame naming the mutated file instead of the deepest: `<module>` calling `main()` is then blamed, and a span covering only the call line reads hollow though nothing was raised there.
mutations.find:
if lines and first <= lines[-1] <= last:
            return f"{exception} at {target}:{lines[-1]}"
mutations.replace:
if lines and first <= lines[0] <= last:
            return f"{exception} at {target}:{lines[0]}"

mutations.name: a-guards-own-exception-reads-hollow
mutations._mechanism: Drops the builtin filter. A guard's own refusal (`StateWriteError`, `SpecError`) raised at the replacement — the 2026-10-04 sweep's commonest real crash kill — would be called hollow.

mutations.name: a-deletion-gets-a-span
mutations._mechanism: A blank replacement gets the line it deleted as its span, so whatever crash lands on the line that moved up is blamed on code that does not exist.

mutations.name: the-span-stops-at-the-first-line
mutations._mechanism: A multi-line replacement is scored on its first line only, so a crash on its later lines reads as downstream.

mutations.name: the-targeted-branch-stops-reporting-hollow
mutations._mechanism: The wire, severed on the targeted path: `hollow_kill` still works and nothing calls it, so `hollow_kills=0` everywhere — the exact silence the row exists to end.

mutations.name: the-untargeted-branch-stops-reporting-hollow
mutations._mechanism: Same wire on the untargeted path, which once lacked every other classification too.

mutations.name: the-sweep-drops-hollow-lines
mutations._mechanism: The corpus reading the refusal must be calibrated on is thrown away: a sweep forwards crash and timeout kills but not which of them were hollow.
